rationale: The customer is asking for a late-return fee to be waived because of a traffic delay, which is a waiver request the return-logistics policy already settles one way or the other.
The customer is flagging something that looks wrong on an invoice and asking for it to be checked, which is a standard billing query.
The customer reports that a rented plate compactor isn't working properly and asks for a repair visit or swap, which is an equipment-servicing request with no injury or safety risk mentioned.
The customer is asking whether a diamond floor saw is available for rent at a given location, a straightforward availability question.
The customer disputes a damage charge as ordinary wear and asks for it to be waived, which is a waiver request the damage-assessment policy already resolves.
The customer disputes a damage charge on a plate compactor as normal wear and asks for it to be waived, again a waiver matter policy already covers.
The customer is asking whether the same hydraulic breaker will be available for a future date, a plain availability check.
The customer wants to add a site cabin to an existing order, a routine booking change.
The customer is asking how and when to return a cement mixer trailer, a standard return-logistics question.
The customer asks whether a cement mixer trailer can be delivered or must be collected, a routine delivery-logistics question.
The customer disputes a late fee, saying nobody was at the depot to receive the equipment on time, and wants the charge removed, a waiver dispute that return-logistics policy already settles.
The customer asks whether the dates on a site fencing booking can still be shifted, a routine booking-change question.
An operator received an electric shock from a rented generator's casing, which is an injury incident and safety risk regardless of the replacement or inspection request also raised.
The customer asks whether a hydraulic concrete breaker can be delivered or needs to be picked up, a routine delivery-logistics question.
The customer wants to move the dates on an existing scaffold tower booking and asks about availability, a routine booking-change request.
